readerCopy.body: A small shift in leverage can create enough room to change a situation that previously had to be worked around. When Pluto sextiles the North Node, power and forward movement cooperate through new information, more money, formal authority, a changed rule, or support from someone who can influence the outcome. The advantage matters most when it changes the setup instead of merely winning one conversation. A stronger position is useful when it leaves more control after the immediate problem is over.
